summary: Seven required models, fourteen native/render pairs and the labeled contact sheet meet the reviewed brief. No change is required.

images.observations: Mixer head, post, deep open bowl, right loop handle and working space around the beater are distinct and unclipped.
Bowl cavity, handle hole and clearance beside the beater remain visible. Larger voxel steps do not obscure the mixer silhouette.
Open cup bay, mug, right steam wand, drip slats and control face read as an espresso machine. Portafilter grip overlaps the cup in projection, consistent with the common camera.
Cup bay, cup loop and slats remain distinct; chunky controls preserve readability. Native checks confirm the cup cavity and handle remain empty.
Two top slots, rear toast slice, side lever and front controls are clearly readable with complete framing.
Both slots remain open around the toast/end gap. Lever and cream body preserve the toaster identity; reduced corner stepping is expected.
Blue-gray jug, cream lid, capacity marks and large handle loop are readable. Opaque glass intentionally hides the interior.
Handle opening remains visible; lid, jug and motor base remain separate silhouette features. Hidden jug cavity is confirmed from native occupancy.
Deep bowl, complete visible rim and two cream handle loops are clear. Dark interior rectangles are occupied dark-metal mounts, independently checked at saved coordinates.
The bowl and both handle loops remain open. The visible wall is continuous and the previously documented handle-cutter puncture is not present in these final files.
Open nonstick bowl, metal rim, connected neck and oak-inset handle are readable. Hanging hole is open; framing includes the full handle.
Bowl remains hollow, hanging hole survives and neck remains visibly connected. Stout handle and stepped interior are intentional low-resolution geometry.
Oak board, juice groove, hanging tab and resting chef knife are distinct. Knife edge and rivets remain legible without clipping.
Board hole and groove persist; blade, guard and handle remain identifiable. Fine grain and edge details simplify as documented.

contact_sheet.observations: All seven actual half previews are labeled, captions are legible, and the title/footer are unclipped.

known_limits: One standardized three-quarter view per variant; no new views, target renders, rebuilds or full development-suite runs were performed.
Opaque blue-gray glass intentionally conceals the blender interior; saved native samples confirm the empty cavity.
Fine wires, knife edges and handles are stout to survive reduction; stair stepping and detail simplification are expected native voxel characteristics.

Owner full authored-grid roundtrip and original 66 feature probes were assessed through frozen evidence. This independent audit reparsed natives, verified exact saved-large to saved-half reduction and rechecked 32 critical empty volumes without importing target authoring code.
